limit.description: How many messages to return, 1 to 100; 20 where left out.

cursor.description: The next_cursor a previous read returned, for its next page.

oldest.description: Only messages sent at or after this time, in ISO 8601.

latest.description: Only messages sent at or before this time, in ISO 8601.

response_format.description: `detailed` (the default) for times and thread info, or `concise` for ids, senders, and words alone.
